description: This file defines a sample implementation of an Android soft keyboard by extending InputMethodService. It handles keyboard initialization, input events, candidate suggestions, and keyboard view management, serving as a basic example for creating custom input methods.

classes.name: SoftKeyboard
classes.description: A subclass of InputMethodService implementing a basic soft keyboard with support for multiple keyboard layouts, candidate suggestions, and input event handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the input method, obtains system services, and sets up word separators.

methods.name: onInitializeInterface
methods.description: Initializes keyboard layouts based on display metrics and configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and returns the main input view for the keyboard layout.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Prepares the keyboard and input state when the user starts editing a text field.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets the input state when finishing editing.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Binds the current keyboard layout to the input view.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Handles cursor movement and text selection changes.

methods.name: onDisplayCompletions
methods.description: Displays candidate suggestions based on editor-provided completions.

methods.name: onCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on changes to the input method subtype (e.g., language).

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Processes key events from the keyboard view, handling character input, deletion, candidate selection, and keyboard switching.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Handles input of text sequences.

methods.name: updateCandidates
methods.description: Updates candidate suggestions based on current composing text.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Displays suggestion list in candidate view.

methods.name: handleBackspace
methods.description: Deletes one character of composing text or sends a delete key event.

methods.name: handleShift
methods.description: Toggles shift or case for the keyboard layout.

methods.name: handleCharacter
methods.description: Handles input of a character key, adding it to the composing text or committing directly.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the keyboard input view.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the window token associated with the input method window.

methods.name: handleLanguageSwitch
methods.description: Switches to the next input method.

methods.name: checkToggleCapsLock
methods.description: Detects double-tap of shift key to toggle caps lock.

methods.name: isWordSeparator
methods.description: Determines if a character code is a word separator.

methods.name: pickDefaultCandidate
methods.description: Selects the top candidate.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Chooses a candidate based on user selection.

methods.name: swipeRight
methods.description: Handles swipe gesture to pick next candidate.

methods.name: swipeLeft
methods.description: Handles swipe gesture to delete or go to previous candidate.

methods.name: swipeDown
methods.description: Handles swipe gesture to close the keyboard.

methods.name: swipeUp
methods.description: Stub for handling upward swipe gestures.
